description: Create a shared AI abstraction layer that supports multiple AI providers (Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) through the Vercel AI SDK. This foundation should allow DevOps teams to configure the active AI provider and model via environment variables while keeping the organization settings UI focused on enabling/disabling AI capabilities.
functional_requirements: Implement a reusable @formbricks/ai package that provides server-side abstraction for AI provider resolution and model selection
Support configuration of Google Cloud Platform (Vertex AI), AWS (Bedrock), and Azure (Microsoft Foundry/Azure OpenAI) as AI providers
Create environment variable-based configuration system with ACTIVE_AI_PROVIDER and ACTIVE_AI_MODEL variables that DevOps teams can set
Build a provider registry/adapter structure that allows easy addition of new AI providers without modifying core logic
Implement web-side AI runtime helpers that combine instance configuration, organization toggles, and entitlement checks
Maintain the existing organization settings UI with two AI capability toggles (Smart functionality and Data enrichment & analysis)
